watch.summary: After making an epic save in Rocket League and yelling triumphantly, the streamer whiffs the very next hit and admits he exhausted all his aura points.

beats.what: Makes an epic save while shouting 'Not on my watch man, get him outta here!'
Completely whiffs the simple follow-up ball and screams in frustration.
Calmly accepts defeat, stating he used up all his aura points on the save.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I think I used up all my aura points to save that stuff man.
watch.why: The instant collapse from loud hubris after a great save to immediately whiffing an easy shot provides great comedic timing. His quiet, self-aware punchline delivers the perfect punch to close out the clip.
